summary: Explore advanced financial reporting standards in our comprehensive course. Enhance your skills and stay updated with the latest industry practices.
lede: Advanced financial reporting standards work helps finance professionals interpret complex transactions and present supportable accounting positions. For those who prepare, review, audit, or approve complex reporting, the course develops skills in documenting estimates, applying IFRS 9, IFRS 15, and IFRS 16 requirements, and drafting clear disclosures and audit-ready workpapers. Participants also practice reviewing controls and turning technical judgments into concise reporting narratives.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who prepare, review, audit, or approve complex financial reporting under IFRS or comparable standards.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of financial statements, basic accounting principles, and the reporting cycle. Familiarity with IFRS or another recognized financial reporting framework is strongly recommended, along with experience reviewing ledgers, journal entries, or disclosure notes. No programming or coding is required. Advanced topics are taught at the operational application level, with selected areas such as integrated reporting and digital close workflows introduced at a conceptual level.
